SPIT Borrowed: PETA's Walang Aray | PETA Theater Center, 5 Eymard Drive, New Manila, Quezon City | Sept. 21, 2025 | 7:00 PM | https://t.co/Av2p17m5gg

The SPIT Crew’s ready to step onto the Teatro Zorrilla stage in this Borrowed Walang Aray No Ouch. Tawa Only show! For a special one-night show,this Borrowed Walang Aray brings SPIT Manila’s wittiest, zaniest, and most revoLOLtionary improv performance to all the mangingibigs out there.

Join us for a two-hour traffic on the stage with performances drawing inspiration from PETA’s awarded musical, Walang Aray!
